scenario_results.description: 36 active agents, canary GREEN, CRO LOW, but zero picks for 5 days. This is a genuine pipeline failure — not CRO blocking.
CRO=HIGH is blocking buys. Pipeline ran fine. PipelineLogicAgent should NOT fire pipeline dark — this is expected.
FI agents are in the registry but fi_pipeline_report is 10 days old.
All 3 pods have $30k budget but zero positions and CRO is LOW. No excuse for idle capital — this is a deployment failure.
Pods idle because CRO=CRITICAL. This is the right posture.
Board meeting report is missing entirely — governance gap.
CRO=HIGH for 20 cycles (80 days) with no board vote. This should trigger governance finding.
ST model AUC dropped to 0.47 — worse than random. Must be flagged.
AUC=0.63, portfolio +3%, all systems normal. Clean run.
Only 3 active agents remain out of 38. Mass retirement should trigger health alert.
15 agents simultaneously on Performance Improvement Plans. Statistically impossible without a system-level cause.
CRO has blocked all buys for 12+ cycles. No positions opened. This is strategy paralysis.
ML pod has $30k but zero live picks logged. Can't know if model works.
